messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["av block", "heart block", "first-degree heart block", "second-degree or third-degree heart block", "opioids can block pain-relieving effect", "heart block beyond the first degree", "medicines that block the liver enzyme CYP2D6", "drugs that block or speed up CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 enzymes", "blocks male hormones", "ARB use", "blocking them", "blocking male hormones", "blockage in stomach or intestines", "blocks histamine", "Schedule V", "SURPASS-CVOT"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
